places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Evening on the outfit's porch; piano music drifts from the Dry Bean saloon, where Lorena lives upstairs.
places.location_hint: south Texas, north bank of the Rio Grande

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call walks the river alone every night, keeping old Ranger habits and watching for trouble that rarely comes.

places.name: Comanche crossing near Lonesome Dove
places.note: Old Comanche raiding ford by a salt lick; Call sits on a small bluff there nightly, once turning back a lone rider.
places.location_hint: on the Rio Grande a short walk west of Lonesome Dove, near a salt lick

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Comanches once raided into it via the crossing; a would-be intruder retreated back into it.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Call reflects that few free Comanches remain even to threaten the upper Brazos.

places.name: Fort Phantom Hill
places.note: Pea Eye recalls Call finding a large band of Indians near there in Ranger days.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus's booming voice is famous across the state.

places.name: Virginia
places.note: Augustus spent a year at a college there and still boasts of his Greek and Latin.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: Newt dreams of riding off with the Captain to this grassy country he has only heard about.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at their house; Augustus heading down to the Dry Bean saloon
